sentinel_rules: Sentinels are axis-specific conditions tagged with a `sentinel` field. Stochastic sentinel conditions run at all 3 seeds. SACE runs only on sentinel-tagged conditions, and only for Xenium 7-type and sim (never Xenium 6-type). Aggregation key = (sentinel, axis). Per unit: 1 baseline + moderate (3 stochastic axes x 3 seeds + 1 ablation = 10) + severe (10) + zero (1) = 22 SACE conditions. The severe type_removal panel is resolved per profile (last non-zero entry of type_removal_series).
